scope_statement: Offline synthetic/model inventory only. Entries with scope SYNTHETIC_HOST_MODEL describe objects the host-side harness creates and can inspect. Entries with scope HONDA_TARGET describe target properties that no existing evidence establishes; every one is UNKNOWN.

RAM_BACKED_VOLATILE.meaning: Storage whose contents are lost on reboot because it is memory-backed.
RAM_BACKED_VOLATILE.model_note: The harness models this class with a scratch directory it wipes in simulate_reboot(). That wipe is a model assumption, not an observation of any target.

PERSISTENT_DATA.meaning: Storage that survives reboot (for example a /data partition).
PERSISTENT_DATA.model_note: The harness models this class with a scratch directory that simulate_reboot() leaves in place, so leftover files must be removed by explicit cleanup.

UNKNOWN_PLATFORM.meaning: Storage whose reboot behavior is not established by any existing evidence.
UNKNOWN_PLATFORM.model_note: Treated conservatively as persistent: simulate_reboot() does not wipe it, and its files remain cleanup obligations.

platform_unknowns.subject: /data/local/tmp
platform_unknowns.note: /data/local/tmp is not established as reboot-volatile. It is classed UNKNOWN_PLATFORM and, where mentioned, is persistent-until-proven-otherwise. No existing evidence shows what is mounted there or whether it survives reboot.

platform_unknowns.subject: any memory-backed mount on the target
platform_unknowns.note: Whether a RAM-backed mount exists, where, and with what limits is not established.

platform_unknowns.subject: what the target does with project-owned state across reboot
platform_unknowns.note: A simulated reboot in this harness proves nothing about it.

files.note: Host scratch file in the modelled volatile directory (producer pid record).
Host scratch file in the modelled persistent directory (staging record).
Host scratch file in a directory whose reboot behavior the model deliberately leaves unestablished.
Whether any file would ever be placed on the target, where, and its storage class are undetermined. Nothing is staged on a target.

processes.note: Host-side producer connection/process; SIGKILL, exit and silence are covered by the CL-INT-04 subprocess tests.
The existing CL-INT-04 host service and server, reused unchanged.
Target process model, lifetime and supervision are not established.

sockets.note: Mode-0600 Unix socket in a host scratch directory; removed by Display1HostServer.stop().
No Honda IPC endpoint or transport contract is established.

services.note: Host-owned expiry timer thread of Display1HostService.
Target service registration, restart policy and ownership are not established.

mounts.note: Three ordinary host directories; no mount is created or inspected. The 'volatile' one is a plain directory the model wipes.
Target mount points, filesystem types and options (including any tmpfs and the /data partition) are not established.

display1_leases.note: The one CL-INT-04 Display1LeaseHost lease/epoch/generation fence. The harness adds no second lease system.
No Honda Display 1 ownership, lease or withdrawal contract is established; CL-INT-04 is synthetic.

cleanup_obligations.note: The harness-owned producer connection is closed.
Confirmed through the host's own status: no lease held, nothing visible, no residual, no pending withdrawal. An unreachable host is UNKNOWN, never clean.
A missing file is UNKNOWN unless the model itself wiped it in a simulated reboot.
Survives simulated reboot; must be removed explicitly. A missing file is UNKNOWN.
Treated as persistent. A missing file is UNKNOWN.
Released by EphemeralHarness.close() through Display1HostServer.stop(), which reports whether everything ended.
Target-side cleanup, restoration and reboot recovery are not established and cannot be established offline.
